# Garden Deliveries are accessible in the Texts application inside the phone.

# They function as produce deliveries that reward you with [https://trello.com/c/TgTg3eR6/188-coins](https://trello.com/c/TgTg3eR6/188-coins "smartCard-inline") and [https://trello.com/c/qL0mXi41/765-garden-exp](https://trello.com/c/qL0mXi41/765-garden-exp "smartCard-inline").

# When delivering produce you can try and haggle for a higher reward.
